notes: ACCESS: no Claude/bot-specific Disallow in robots.txt (only a generic '*' group with narrow param/path exclusions unrelated to category browsing); Sitemap: https://www.freedom.com.au/sitemap.xml -> categorysitemap.xml (235 curated category URLs) + productsitemap_1/2.xml (94,232 bare /product/{id} URLs, no category association, not useful for per-category counts). Direct fetch of every category page returned HTTP 200 with full server-rendered SEO shell (title/meta/breadcrumb JSON-LD) -- no block at any point. PLATFORM: Freedom (Greenlit Brands) runs SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris)/Spartacus Angular SPA, baseSiteId 'freedomfurniture', backend api-prod.freedom.com.au. Product listing/count data is fetched client-side only, via a Coveo headless search widget (coveoTrackingId 'freedom_au', searchHub 'freedomaucontent') -- confirmed via main-QWXWCR66.js bundle inspection. No product count appears anywhere in the server HTML (checked JSON-LD -- only BreadcrumbList present, no ItemList/numberOfItems). QTY ATTEMPTS (Rule 2 full sweep, same platform family as S.N. 163 Galeries Lafayette precedent): (1) direct fetch -- SPA shell only, no data; (2) WebFetch -- confirmed same CSR shell, no count text; (3) r.jina.ai -- hit a Cloudflare managed-challenge page for freedom.com.au itself (not a Claude block, a generic bot challenge); (4) translate.goog -- returned the same untranslated CSR shell (no JS execution); (5) obtained a real anonymous OAuth bearer token from /authorizationserver/oauth/token using the storefront's own public client_id 'mobile_android' (same technique validated on S.N. 163); found via the JS bundle that this site's OCC prefix is a custom '/greenlitrest/v2/' (not the default '/occ/v2/'); calling /greenlitrest/v2/freedomfurniture/products/search with that token returned HTTP 400 'Base site freedomfurnitureC: doesn't exist' for every request tried (with and without query params) -- endpoint not exposed/working at this gateway for the confirmed-valid baseSiteId, a dead end consistent with S.N. 163's finding that even a working token+endpoint combination on this platform family ends up non-functional for filtered counts. The Coveo search token itself is fetched at runtime from a separate lazy-loaded chunk not present in the main bundle, so it could not be obtained either. No further Rule 2 route remained; browser automation is prohibited. CATEGORY STRUCTURE: built from the live homepage mega-menu (400 links captured via nav dump) cross-checked against categorysitemap.xml; every node below was independently confirmed live with a 200-status direct fetch and a distinct, page-specific server-rendered <title>/meta description (not a generic shell). RULE 0 GAINS: Kids Lighting, Kids Wall Art, Kids Mirrors kept in-scope as room/audience-based nodes, not excluded for the 'Kids' framing; Outdoor Lighting kept in-scope. RULE 0.6 / FACET RE-CUTS DROPPED (not separately counted, all re-cuts of the single 'Wall Art' or 'Mirrors' listings): Wall Art by style (Aboriginal/Abstract/Coastal/Photographic/Still Life/Floral & Botanical/Landscape), by size (Small/Medium/Large/Oversized) and by colour (Neutral/White/Black/Grey/Blue/Green/Pink); Mirrors by shape (Full Length/Wall/Arched/Round) and Bathroom Mirrors (nested facet of Mirrors). EXCLUSIONS: Cushions, Throws, Pouffes & Floor Cushions, Outdoor Cushions, Curtains (textiles); Curtain Accessories (title-only inspection possible, predominantly curtain hardware/tracks/hooks, could not verify a clean tieback/rod-only split so dropped per 'mixed roll-up: drop, don't pad'); all Rugs incl. Outdoor Rugs (textile); Wall Decals & Panels (adhesive wall stickers, treated like wallpaper -- not a genuine wall-art/decor object); Candles under Home Fragrance and Candles (page title literally 'Scented, Unscented Candle & Jar Candles' -- a mixed roll-up that cannot be split by title inspection since the SPA blocks per-product data; kept the genuinely unscented LED Candles node and Candle Holders & Accessories instead, per the 'unscented candles'/'candle holders' include rule); Reed Diffusers, Hand & Body Care (home fragrance/personal care); Globes (light bulbs, explicit exclusion); Cutlery; Napery -- Tablecloths & Runners, Placemats & Napkins, Coasters (table linens); Kitchen Storage (wine racks etc., storage furniture); Water Bottles (canonical URL redirects to kitchen-and-tableware/kitchenware/c/water-bottles -- filed by the site itself as functional Kitchenware, not decorative Glassware); Cookbooks, Books (not decor); Artificial Flowers & Plants (explicit exclusion); Outdoor Accessories (page title 'Outdoor Cushion & Outdoor Covers' -- textile/functional, not decorative); Outdoor Storage, Outdoor Covers, Outdoor Umbrellas & Stands, Outdoor Protection (functional/furniture); Servingware/Tableware/Glassware siblings not decor-relevant (Kitchen Storage etc. as above); all Shop by Brands/Best Selling/New Arrivals/All-* roll-up and clearance pages (never-extract). JUDGMENT CALL: Lamp Shades (wall-art-mirrors-and-lighting/globes-and-accessories/c/lamp-shades) kept in-scope as a decorative lighting accessory distinct from the excluded Globes (bulbs) node in the same nav group -- flagged for reviewer awareness. Portable Lamps kept as a distinct leaf from Table Lamps (site markets it as a separate cordless/rechargeable product type, title 'Table Lamps Cordless & Wireless Lamps') though possible product-ID overlap with Table Lamps could not be verified. Duplicate nav placements resolved to a single row: 'Pots & Planters' is linked from both /c/outdoor-pots-and-planters and cushions-throws-and-decor/home-accessories/c/outdoor-pots-and-planters -- same category, one row, canonical short URL used as link.
